name: account-room
description: Records each Claude account's rate limit readings, and when this account runs low names the account with the most room, with a Switch button.

readingsRepo.title: Readings repository
readingsRepo.description: The private GitHub repository, as owner/name, where each Mac writes its readings file (readings/<Mac>.json) through gh.

logoutCommand.title: Browser logout command
logoutCommand.description: Shell command that signs claude.ai out in the browser. Empty until the route is proven (#659), so Switch stops at the sign out.

signedOutCheck.title: Signed out check
signedOutCheck.description: Shell command that prints exactly 'signed out' once the browser is signed out of claude.ai.
